query: CREATE TABLE deployment(id UUID NOT NULL, name CITEXT NOT NULL, registry VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registry.patr.cloud', repository_id UUID, image_name VARCHAR(512), image_tag VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, workspace_id UUID NOT NULL, runner UUID NOT NULL, min_horizontal_scale SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, max_horizontal_scale SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, machine_type UUID NOT NULL, deploy_on_push BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, startup_probe_port INTEGER, startup_probe_path VARCHAR(255), startup_probe_port_type EXPOSED_PORT_TYPE, liveness_probe_port INTEGER, liveness_probe_path VARCHAR(255), liveness_probe_port_type EXPOSED_PORT_TYPE, current_live_digest TEXT, deleted TIMESTAMPTZ, should_run BOOLEAN NOT NULL, observed_status OBSERVED_DEPLOYMENT_STATUS, status DEPLOYMENT_STATUS NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN NOT should_run AND (observed_status IS NULL OR observed_status = 'stopped') THEN 'stopped'::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS WHEN NOT should_run THEN 'stopping'::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS WHEN (observed_status IS NULL OR observed_status = 'stopped') THEN 'deploying'::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS WHEN observed_status = 'deploying' THEN 'deploying'::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS WHEN observed_status = 'running' THEN 'running'::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS WHEN observed_status = 'crashing' THEN 'crashing'::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS WHEN observed_status = 'health_check_failing' THEN 'health_check_failing'::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS WHEN observed_status = 'image_pull_failed' THEN 'image_pull_failed'::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS WHEN observed_status = 'invalid_architecture' THEN 'invalid_architecture'::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS WHEN observed_status = 'errored' THEN 'errored'::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS END) STORED);
